description: Which bytes change when a Null fixed field (Fx.Fl of row 8, whose other fixed fields stay Null) is updated to a value? Fx: ten rows on one small table (ID Long key; Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, Decimal Fm and a trailing Text Vt); row 8 is Null in Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft and Fm. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
